effectSummary.ko: 10m 안의 반경 4m에 화염 D200%, 0.5초 뒤 냉기 D150%, 다시 0.5초 뒤 번개 D150%를 가합니다. 각 단계 최대 8명이며 냉기는 1초 빙결을 줍니다. M01·M02·M03을 대신 시전한 것으로 세지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Strike a 4m area within 10m for D200% fire, then D150% cold after 0.5s, then D150% lightning after another 0.5s. Each stage hits up to 8 enemies; cold freezes for 1s. These stages do not count as M01, M02 or M03 casts.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: HELLSCRIPT Mage skill icon, M17 Triune Collapse / 삼원소 붕괴, ultimate.
Primary request: Create ONE original independent 1024x1024 PNG icon with REAL NATIVE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. An overwhelming tri-element collapse: a massive jagged central implosion core made of interlocking molten-orange flame, cyan crystalline ice and white-violet lightning slabs. Three distinct heavy elemental wedges crash together into one brilliant focal impact, with very few large debris fragments. Ultimate power through unusually strong central mass, no decorative frame or scenery.
Effect context: Strike a 4m area within 10m for D200% fire, then D150% cold after 0.5s, then D150% lightning after another 0.5s. Each stage hits up to 8 enemies; cold freezes for 1s. These stages do not count as M01, M02 or M03 casts.
Relevant equipment linkage: DES_LM46. Match the effect rather than copying existing item art.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy game art, sculptural large shapes, restrained tactile brush texture, somber charcoal shadows, weathered materials where relevant, pale high-contrast edges, selective saturated magic. Two or three major forms, minimal tiny particles. Legible and individually recognizable at 64px.
Composition: centered cohesive isolated subject, every visible shape and glow fully inside the central 76 percent of the square canvas; at least 12 percent completely transparent padding on all four sides. Only the depicted skill, no surrounding scene.
Output: exactly 1024x1024 PNG with native RGBA alpha. All surrounding and internal empty space truly transparent. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges, no opaque matte or halo.
Avoid: any background or solid backdrop, checkerboard picture, floor, ground, cast shadow, stand, UI panel, frame, border, lettering, written runes, digits, ID labels, logo or watermark. Do not copy or recolor an existing icon.

readability64.en: Large fire, ice and lightning wedges collide in one dense ultimate impact.

edges.en: Native output and 256px light/dark inspection showed no opaque matte, backdrop pattern or clipped main form. Very low-alpha border pixels remain recorded warnings.
